mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucagon to the liver was worthwhile because it connected a pancreatic message to stored glucose becoming available between meals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Releasing the two messages felt somewhat repetitive, although the different meal conditions gave each pathway a purpose.

surprise.text: The muscle store made it clear that insulin stays outside the cells as a message rather than becoming part of the stored carbohydrate.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and goals named the connections, though they made the choices fairly predictable.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the two pathways side by side helped me understand how the body handles glucose at different times, even if the combinations were straightforward.
